SMTO-CFG-0101 — The Activity supervision timings don't fit together

GUID: 4594b86d-3e99-5f0b-b438-0036429acb71
Slug: activity-supervision-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: activity

What happened

  • SMTO checks on long-running work at set times. These timings are out of order, or a check interval is longer than the allowed maximum, so SMTO didn't accept them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Operate › Long-running Activity supervision. This section holds the timings SMTO uses to watch long-running work.
  2. Set Attention after no progress (seconds) to a number the box accepts; it can't be lower than SMTO's earlier warning time. The default is 180. SMTO asks for attention last, after its earlier warnings, so this time can't be shorter than theirs.
  3. Set Normal health inspection interval (seconds) to a number from 1 to 60. The default is 25. A check interval longer than the maximum gap between checks would leave work unwatched.

What success looks like

  • The message Activity supervision saved appears, and new Tasks start without this message.

If it still fails

  • If the section shows Could not load Activity supervision settings, the saved timings are damaged; send Copy error details to the person who manages SMTO. Tasks already running keep the timings they started with, so you don't need to stop them.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • ActivitySupervisionPolicy validation failed: quiet_after_seconds <= suspect_after_seconds <= attention_after_seconds does not hold, or healthy_observation_seconds or long_healthy_observation_seconds exceeds max_observation_seconds.

What this means

  • Supervision thresholds are not nondecreasing from quiet through suspect to attention, or healthy observation intervals exceed max_observation_seconds. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Supervision thresholds are not nondecreasing from quiet through suspect to attention, or healthy observation intervals exceed max_observation_seconds.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the ordered thresholds and both normal/long healthy observation intervals; equal thresholds are allowed.

How to fix it

  • Correct the stored activity_supervision_policy (global UI settings namespace or the per-conversation supervision namespace) so the quiet, suspect and attention thresholds are nondecreasing and both healthy intervals are no larger than max_observation_seconds (src/agent_runtime/native/activity_supervision_policy.py). Save it with PUT /api/agent/activity-supervision, or send policy null to restore product defaults.
  • Set quiet, suspect and attention thresholds in nondecreasing order and keep inspection intervals within the maximum.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • Thresholds are nondecreasing and observation intervals fit their configured maximum.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.
